hub.firstThenHint: A simple visual for the next step
hub.laddersHint: Small steps toward one new food
hub.laddersHintChain: Small steps or food chains toward new foods
hub.logHint: Every try and how it is going

safe.title: {{name}}'s safe foods
safe.intro: Safe foods are always offered at meals, so there is something to eat while new foods are explored.
safe.empty: No safe foods yet. Add the foods {{name}} eats most days.
safe.loseBody: It's common for a safe food to drop off. We'll keep a note of it so you and {{name}}'s therapist can see the change.

sensory.title: {{name}}'s sensory profile
sensory.upsellBody: Premium lets you keep the profile up to date, and plans and chains follow it.
sensory.saved: Saved. New plans and chains will follow it.

ladders.title: {{name}}'s ladders
ladders.intro: A ladder moves toward one food in small steps: on the table, look, touch, smell, lick, taste and eat. Stay at a step as long as needed.
ladders.upsellBody: Premium adds step-by-step ladders and food-chain suggestions built from the sensory profile.

ladder.missing: This ladder is no longer available.
ladder.title: Ladder: {{food}}

suggestion.advance: Three calm tries. Ready to move up when you are.
suggestion.stay: Keep going at this step. There is no hurry.
suggestion.step_back: Two hard tries in a row. A step back can help.

ladder.upBody: The next step will be shown at meals from now on.
ladder.completeBody: This is the last step. Mark the ladder for {{food}} as completed?
ladder.downBody: Going back is part of the process, not a setback.
ladder.completed: Ladder completed. {{food}} can now join the safe foods.
ladder.removeBody: Tries already logged stay in the food log.

editor.fromChat: Suggested in chat. Check the steps; nothing is saved until you tap Save.
editor.pickProposalFood: Pick {{food}} from the catalog so the ladder can be saved.
editor.startHint: Only safe foods linked to the catalog can start a chain.
editor.noSafeFoods: Add a safe food from the catalog first.
editor.noChain: No close chain found. Add bridge foods yourself below.
editor.conflict: There is already an active ladder for this food. Open it from the list, or pause it first.
editor.note: Suggestions use textures and colours only. Check each food is right for your child.

criteria.tolerate_on_table: The food stays on the table during the meal without upset.
criteria.look: Looks at the food on their own plate or a side plate.
criteria.touch: Touches the food with a finger or a utensil.
criteria.smell: Brings the food close and smells it.
criteria.lick: Touches the food to the lips or tongue.
criteria.taste: Takes a tiny taste; spitting it out is fine.
criteria.chew_spit: Chews a small piece and may spit it out.
criteria.eat_portion: Eats a small portion as part of the meal.

firstThen.title: First, then: {{name}}
firstThen.thenHint: Always an activity, never a food reward.
